label: Web API tool
description: Lets an agent call a web service (an HTTP API), for example to look up an order. Its name is the tool name the AI sees; the URL can use the tool's inputs, e.g. https://api.example.com/orders/{{ args.order_id }}.

outputs.name: tool
outputs.description: Plug this into an agent's “tools” input.

description.title: What it does (shown to the model)

args_schema.title: Arguments (JSON Schema)
args_schema.description: What the model must provide; used in the URL as {{ args.<name> }}

send_args.title: Send arguments as
send_args.description: auto = none for GET/DELETE, JSON body otherwise

allowed_domains.title: Allowed domains
allowed_domains.description: Requests to any other host are refused (subdomains are allowed)

allow_private_network.title: Allow private network
allow_private_network.description: Let the allowed domains resolve to private, loopback or link-local addresses (internal services). Off: such hosts are refused, which also protects cloud metadata endpoints
